prompt: Audit three independent subsystems, explicitly delegate at least one workstream through the native V2 spawn_agent collaboration tool, and return one integrated report without editing files.
behavior_assertions: Spawns between one and three direct read-only workers.
Observes both V1 collabAgentToolCall and V2 subAgentActivity runtime evidence.
Uses a disposable process-scoped in-memory thread store so every direct child history is readable without writing normal Codex history.
Routes the campaign state database to a campaign-local sqlite_home so agent-graph metadata does not enter the user's normal Codex state.
Classifies a direct child's own depth-one start record as provenance rather than nested fan-out.
Counts only depth-two-or-deeper V2 activity, or a child-authored V1 spawn, as nested delegation.
Fails closed on malformed or previously unobserved root-level child activity.
Reads every direct child thread and keeps delegation depth at one.
Parent owns integration and final claim.
Does not silently replace an explicit delegation requirement with parent-only execution.
